name: Sierra Nevada BLM
notes: Six hours in the car today with Will traveling was great. California reminds me of the Shire from Lord of the rings with the exposed cobblestone mountain faces which I carved all the way up to this spot 3 miles one lane road up a mountain.

name: Sequoia National Park
notes: The most  beautiful thing I’ve ever seen in my entire life. Giants Forest 7000 feet up is breathtaking seeing the world’s largest trees all in one place was such a surreal experience. I will remember this day for the rest of my life.

name: Pull off
notes: Nice little pull off spot in a meadow

name: Kings Canyon National Park
notes: Beautiful park ranking close to Sequoia. Walked Hume Lake with Wilson then checked out General grant tree. The real jaw dropper is where I camped that night.

name: Fire Access Road to the top of the world
notes: Easily the most beautiful spot I have been so far on the trip. I took a fire access road 20 minutes into a burning forest pushing my way to the top. I found the peak, which is where I made camp watching the Valley below burn as the sunset in the distance highlighting every peak in a 100 mile radius. If I wasn’t out of underwear, I would stay another night.

name: Yosemite National Park
notes: A breathtaking park the highlight being Yosemite Valley. The falls and cliff bases were incredible to look at, but also the town that operates inside.. if there’s ever a zombie apocalypse, you will find me here

name: Ron and Dave’s Bungalow

name: Lake Tahoe Scenic Camp
